S.FORM: alang Tgbin ga niya mki sku Taycyo Si atu Wahe'i go, kwara sali buwan nya ga 135 buwan, 424 hi ku kwara s'uli tayan. s'uli tayan pinspngan Gyencumin ga 72% kyan ku 306 hi, binah ga, 'yat kahun sku pinspngan Gyencumin ga 28% kyan ku 118 hi nya. pinspung na linhuyan Gyencumin ga, Tayan 69%, Paywan 1%, Bunun 1%. maki qu ngasal bziran ru kyokay. rhzyal kki'an tay 'llaw na Tgbin hya' ga llyung. tay 'zil na Tgbin hya' ga llyung. tay mkyahu' na Tgbin hya' ga rgyax krahu'. tay mkraya' na Tgbin hya' ga llyung. tay mkyahu' na Tgbin hya' ga L'olu. rekisi kayal kyokay maki 1 kyokay. ssquliq pinlpgan ppqbaqan pqwasan biru 'laqi' cikuy pqwasan biru 'laqi' mrkyas tuqi 'san basu kisya' glgan spyangan na pinbahu Ubuy qqmayh
S.PHON: alaŋ tɣβin ɣa nija mki [s|ɕ]ku taj[ʦ|ʨ]jo [s|ɕ]i atu waħeʔi ɣo kwara [s|ɕ]ali βuwan nja ɣa *** βuwan *** ħi ku kwara [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku *** ħi βinaħ ɣa ʔjat kaħun [s|ɕ]ku pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku *** ħi nja pin[s|ɕ]puŋ na linħujan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa tajan ** pajwan * βunun * maki qu ŋa[s|ɕ]al βziran ru kjokaj rħzjal kkiʔan taj ʔllaw na tɣβin ħjaʔ ɣa lljuŋ taj ʔzil na tɣβin ħjaʔ ɣa lljuŋ taj mkjaħuʔ na tɣβin ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax kraħuʔ taj mkrajaʔ na tɣβin ħjaʔ ɣa lljuŋ taj mkjaħuʔ na tɣβin ħjaʔ ɣa lʔolu reki[s|ɕ]i kajal kjokaj maki * kjokaj [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq pinlpɣan ppqβaqan pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ [ʦ|ʨ]ikuj pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ mrkja[s|ɕ] tuqi ʔ[s|ɕ]an βa[s|ɕ]u ki[s|ɕ]jaʔ ɣlɣan [s|ɕ]pjaŋan na pinβaħu uβuj qqmajħ
